trace.query: What are the sanctions for a first offense of cyber bullying?

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_504
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.

Sec. 1. Acts of Cybercrime (Stipulated by RA 10175 or the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012).

1.1. Cyber bullying or bullying done through the use of technology or any electronic means
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

1.2. Illegal access or hacking to the whole or any part of one’s online accounts including e -mail, social media profiles, etc.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

1.3. Illegal interception or listening to, recording, monitoring or surveillance of the content of communications, either directly through the access and use of computer systems, or indirectly through the use of electronic eavesdropping or tapping devices
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_507
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
and Discourtesy. Defiant attitude indicated by acts of belligerence, gross and deliberate discourtesy toward fellow student, teachers, employees and other University authorities.
 1st Offense: suspension for one (1) week, 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution, and letter of apology
 2nd Offense: suspension for one (1) month with letter of apology
 3rd Offense: suspension for one (1) semester depending on the gravity of the offense

Sec. 3. Breach of Peace. Creating within the University premises disorder, tumult, serious disturbance, and other forms of disturbances such as shouting, racing, roaming in corridors and the like while classes are going on.

3.1. Shouting and roaming in the corridor/pathways
 1st Offense: reprimand
 2nd Offense: suspension for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 3rd Offense: suspension for one (1) month

3.2. Subsequent offense
 Sanction (all offenses): suspension for one (1)semester

Sec. 4. Bringing of Deadly Weapons. Carrying within the University premises any firearm/s, knife with a blade longer than 2- 1/2 inches, ice pick, explosive/s or any other dangerous or deadly weapon/s is a major offense.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_509
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
Suspension for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 3rd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester

5.2. Creating a hostile environment at school for the other student, infringing on the rights of the other student at school, or materially and substantially disrupting his/her education process.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 3rd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester

5.3. Unwanted physical contact between the bully and the victim like punching, pushing, etc. and the use of available objects as weapons
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

5.4. Any slanderous statement or accusation that causes the victim undue emotional distress like directing foul language or profanity at the target, name-calling, impersonating or calling/giving derogatory names etc.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

Sec. 6.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_510
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
calling/giving derogatory names etc.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

Sec. 6. Drinking/Alcohol-related Concerns. Drinking alcoholic beverages or exhibition of any drunken behavior within the University premises.

6.1. Drinking alcoholic beverages
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

6.2. Any drunkenness or drunken behavior resulting in physical injuries to other person/s or destruction of property/ies.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month and payment of damages
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester and payment for damages
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University and payment of damages

Sec. 7. Deception and Forgery. Intentional making of a false statement of any material or fact, or practicing or attempting to practice any deception or fraud in connection with his admission registration in or graduation from the University. (Forging signature and falsifying public documents.)
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1)

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_505
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
directly through the access and use of computer systems, or indirectly through the use of electronic eavesdropping or tapping devices
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

1.4. Data interference or the intentional or reckless alteration, damaging, deletion or deterioration of computer data, electronic document or electronic message, without right, including introduction or transmission of viruses
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

1.5. Computer-related fraud, forgery and identity theft or the intentional acquisition, use, misuse, transfer, possession, alteration or deletion of identifying information belonging to another person.

1.6. Cybersex or the willful engagement, maintenance, control or operation, directly or indirectly, of any lascivious exhibition of sexual organs or sexual activity, with the aid of a computer system, for favor or consideration.
 Sanction (all offenses): expulsion from the University

1.7.
